title: Cozy Cats Coloring Book for Kids Ages 6-12
subtitle: Cute & Cuddly Cat Designs with Bold Easy Outlines
description: Meet the coziest cats around! This adorable coloring book features 5 cute and cuddly cat scenes perfect for kids ages 6-12. From napping kittens to playful cats with yarn, each page has bold, thick outlines that are easy to color with crayons or markers. Hours of creative fun for young cat lovers!
keywords: cute cats coloring book for kids
cover_prompt: A vibrant, full-color professional children's book cover illustration featuring an adorable cartoon cat curled up on a soft cushion, surrounded by colorful yarn balls, tiny paw prints, and floating hearts. Bright cheerful colors — warm oranges, pinks, soft purples, and yellows. The cat has big round sparkling eyes and a happy smile. Cute cartoon style, eye-catching and appealing to kids. Professional children's book cover art quality. DO NOT include any text, letters, or words in the image. This is for a Coloring Book for Kids Ages 6-12.
